annotations.title: Search cars AutoIsto CZ offers today

description: Use this when the user wants to find a used car for sale in the Czech Republic now. Pass what they are looking for as one short phrase (Czech or Slovak works best), e.g. "toyota rav4 hybrid do 600000 Kč". Returns up to 20 cars from AutoIsto CZ's offer in its own order, each with a link to the car on www.autoisto.cz, plus what was understood, which words were not applied and what had to be relaxed. When suggestIntent is true (nothing or little found, or part of the phrase was dropped), offer the user intent_publish_intent with the same statement so AutoIsto CZ keeps watching. Results come from listings AutoIsto CZ aggregates from the Czech market and may be incomplete; no seller contact is returned.

limit.description: At most this many cars (default 10; AutoIsto CZ returns at most 10).

statement.description: What the user is looking for, e.g. "suv automat do 500000 Kč".
